name: Moc Chau food guide
summary: The morning cup is cold yogurt or fresh milk in the farm town. At Ban Ang the meal is bamboo sticky rice, grilled stream fish, and jar wine from a gourd.
body: Eat the plateau, not Mai Chau’s rice valley. Ban Ang puts bamboo sticky rice, grilled stream fish, smoked meat, flash-fried calf, love sticky rice, leaf-yeast wine, bamboo-tube fish, and forest greens on one table.

Hmong cooking brings pounded rice cake and thắng cố. Thai and Muong cooking brings hearth-smoked buffalo, five-colour sticky rice, forest greens, and canh bon. Dao cooking brings soured meat with rượu hoẵng. The night market adds dried buffalo and hearth sausage.
specialtiesLead: Start with the Ban Ang table, the morning dairy cup, and the fruit you pick on the hills.

sections.heading: The plateau table
paragraphs: Cooked plates. Pa pỉnh tộp, cá suối, and cá suối nướng are one fish. Thịt hun khói, thịt trâu gác bếp, thịt trâu khô, and bò hun khói are four different meats.

spots.name: Chao calf
spots.address: Bản Áng, about 2 km south of the farm town on National Highway 43

sections.heading: Wine
paragraphs: Five named wines. The night market also sells specialty wines without naming the still.

sections.heading: Dairy and tea
paragraphs: The morning cup is in the farm town. Yogurt comes as three cups: plain, black sticky-rice, and passion-fruit. Fresh milk, milk cake, and the hill tea sit with them. Two visit write-ups list a dairy gate of 20,000 VND and 10,000 VND, both at 08:00–18:00.

spots.note: Yogurt with black sticky rice, from the same plateau dairy set.

sections.heading: Fruit
paragraphs: Hau plum is the fruit with a valley. You pick it at Na Ka from March to May. Dried plum is a different bite. Strawberries, navel oranges, persimmons, apricots, and peaches are fruit you pick and sample.

spots.name: Hau plum
spots.note: Hau plum, ripe and dark red with a white bloom, picked fresh at Na Ka from March to May.

spots.name: Dried hau plum
spots.address: Chiềng Sơn, on the 3 May 2024 announcement
spots.note: Hau plum dried until soft, a different bite from the fresh fruit.

spots.name: Apricots
spots.note: Mơ, the plateau’s apricots, picked fresh.

sections.heading: Packed foods
paragraphs: Bánh khảo, kẹo dồi, and táo mèo are packed to carry home.

spots.name: Tao meo
spots.note: Táo mèo fruit, carried home from the plateau.

spots.name: Banh khao
spots.note: Bánh khảo, a packed cake to carry home from the plateau.

spots.name: Keo doi
spots.note: Kẹo dồi, a candy to carry home from the plateau.

sections.heading: Casual dining
paragraphs: The night market is the walk after dark.

spots.name: Moc Chau night market
spots.address: Farm-town walking street, around the Pha Luong light park
spots.note: More than 2 ha around the Pha Luong light park, with nearly 60 stalls split into a trade side and a food side. Weekends are the fuller nights, and the food side serves dried buffalo and hearth sausage with a cup of strong wine.

sections.heading: Breakfast
paragraphs: The morning cup is plain yogurt, black sticky-rice yogurt, passion-fruit yogurt, or fresh milk in the farm town. Bamboo sticky rice is the other early plate when a Ban Ang meal includes it.
